additions.description: GET /items returns all items without filtering by owner or any other parameter
additions.reasoning: The specification requires that when a superuser retrieves the list of items, the response contains at least the two items created by the superuser, implying superusers can see all items. The code returns all items unconditionally, which is an addition since the specification does not explicitly require returning all items for normal users.

additions.description: GET /users/ returns all users with a top-level 'data' list and 'count' field
additions.reasoning: The specification requires that the list users endpoint returns a 'data' collection and a 'count' key. The code implements this response format, which is more specific than the general requirement to list users.

additions.description: POST /password-recovery-html/{email} returns HTML content embedded in a JSON 'message' field
additions.reasoning: The specification requires returning password recovery HTML content for superusers, but does not specify the format. The code returns the HTML as a string inside a JSON 'message' field, which is an implementation detail not explicitly required.

omissions.description: POST /users/signup returns 400 with detail 'The user with this email already exists in the system' on duplicate email
omissions.reasoning: The specification requires the error detail to be exactly 'The user with this email already exists in the system' when attempting to register a user with an existing email, but the code returns 'User with this email already exists'.

omissions.description: POST /users/signup does not enforce password length minimum of 8 and maximum of 128 characters with 422 status
omissions.reasoning: The specification requires password length validation with 422 status on invalid length during user registration. The code uses Pydantic validators that raise ValueError, which FastAPI converts to 422, so this is implemented correctly. No omission here.

omissions.description: POST /users/signup does not enforce full_name maximum length of 255 characters with 422 status
omissions.reasoning: The specification requires full_name max length validation with 422 status. The code implements this via Pydantic validators, so no omission.

omissions.description: POST /users/signup does not reject invalid email format with 422 status
omissions.reasoning: The code uses EmailStr for email fields, which validates format and returns 422 on invalid format, so this is implemented.

omissions.description: GET /api/v1/items/{item_id} does not check that the requesting user has permission to read the item
omissions.reasoning: The specification requires that a user cannot read an item owned by another user (returns 400 with 'Not enough permissions'). The code returns the item if found without checking ownership or permissions.

omissions.description: PATCH /api/v1/items/{item_id} does not reject updates by users without permission with 400 and 'Not enough permissions'
omissions.reasoning: The code correctly rejects updates by non-superusers who do not own the item with 400 and 'Not enough permissions', so no omission.

omissions.description: DELETE /api/v1/items/{item_id} does not reject deletes by users without permission with 400 and 'Not enough permissions'
omissions.reasoning: The code correctly rejects deletes by non-superusers who do not own the item with 400 and 'Not enough permissions', so no omission.

omissions.description: GET /api/v1/items/{item_id} does not return 400 with 'Not enough permissions' when a user tries to read an item owned by another user
omissions.reasoning: The specification requires 400 with 'Not enough permissions' when a user tries to read another user's item. The code returns 404 if not found but does not check ownership or permissions, so it returns the item regardless of ownership.

omissions.description: PATCH /api/v1/users/me/password does not reject new password equal to current password with 400 and 'New password cannot be the same as the current one'
omissions.reasoning: The code implements this check and raises 400 with the required message, so no omission.

omissions.description: PATCH /api/v1/users/me/password does not reject incorrect current password with 400 and 'Incorrect password'
omissions.reasoning: The code implements this check and raises 400 with the required message, so no omission.

omissions.description: DELETE /api/v1/users/me allows superusers to delete themselves
omissions.reasoning: The code raises 403 with 'Super users are not allowed to delete themselves' when a superuser attempts to delete their own account, matching the specification.

omissions.description: DELETE /api/v1/users/{user_id} does not reject deletion by non-superusers with 403 and 'The user doesn't have enough privileges'
omissions.reasoning: The code raises 403 with the required message if the current user is not superuser, so no omission.

omissions.description: DELETE /api/v1/users/{user_id} does not reject superuser deleting themselves with 403 and 'Super users are not allowed to delete themselves'
omissions.reasoning: The code implements this check and raises 403 with the required message, so no omission.

omissions.description: POST /users/signup does not reject registration with null email or password with 422
omissions.reasoning: The code uses Pydantic models with required fields and validators that raise errors on null values, resulting in 422 responses, so this is implemented.

omissions.description: POST /items/ does not reject creation with empty or too long title or too long description with 422
omissions.reasoning: The code uses Pydantic validators on ItemCreate that enforce title length 1-255 and description max 255, raising validation errors resulting in 422, so this is implemented.

omissions.description: PATCH /users/me does not reject updating email to an existing user's email with 409 and 'User with this email already exists'
omissions.reasoning: The code checks for existing email and raises 409 with the required message, so no omission.

omissions.description: PATCH /users/{user_id} does not reject updating email to an existing user's email with 409 and 'User with this email already exists'
omissions.reasoning: The code checks for existing email and raises 409 with the required message, so no omission.

omissions.description: POST /reset-password/ does not reject invalid token with 400 and 'Invalid token'

omissions.description: POST /reset-password/ does not reject new_password with invalid length with 422
omissions.reasoning: The code uses Pydantic validators on NewPassword model that enforce password length, raising validation errors resulting in 422, so this is implemented.

omissions.reasoning: The code uses UUID type for path parameters, so FastAPI returns 422 on invalid UUID format, matching specification.
